selection: One carryover acceptance plus five remaining original families; infrastructure and repairs are uncounted.

features.name: member_extensions
features.scope: Carryover acceptance of distinct dispatch/extension receivers and computed extension properties; not another new implementation.
restrictions: Source named companions, interface extensions, method-generic setters and generic/inferred/annotated source extension properties remain bounded.

features.name: expanded_enums
features.scope: Entry subclasses, abstract/open methods, interface dispatch/properties, constructor defaults/named arguments, initialization and exceptions, JVM signatures and Kotlin metadata.
restrictions: Abstract enum properties, secondary enum constructors and nested entry declarations remain unsupported.
Enum string interpolation is not included. No whole DevotionActivity or full-app pass is claimed.

features.name: value_classes
features.scope: Single-field value representation, mangling, boxing and Kotlin metadata.
restrictions: Implementation and acceptance are in progress; no validated-family count yet.

features.name: inner_classes
features.scope: Named final inner classes in nongeneric outer classes, enclosing identity/state, initialization, private outer access, source/compiled qualified constructors and bounded constructor references, JVM signatures and Kotlin metadata.
restrictions: Local classes, generic/chained inner classes or generic outer classes, open/abstract inner classes, secondary/default/annotated constructors and enum outers remain explicitly unsupported.
Complete related outer/inner class sets are swapped as providers. Synthetic private-access helper names/visibility may differ; public consumer ABI is checked and raw all-member output retained.
No unchanged whole AndroidBible file or full-app pass is claimed.

features.name: unsigned_values
features.scope: Bounded UInt/ULong scalar semantics through real JVM representation.
restrictions: Implementation and acceptance are in progress; no validated-family count yet.

features.name: suspend_foundation
features.scope: Real bounded suspension/resumption via Continuation state.
restrictions: Implementation and acceptance are in progress; no validated-family count yet.

limitations: Final combined validation is pending. Supported labels refer to bounded feature acceptance, not unrestricted Kotlin or Android compatibility.
